## Specification

### Component: Table

A semantic data table: a native `<table>` in a rounded, scrollable wrapper. Presentational and Server Component–safe.

#### Anatomy
```
<Table>                        .ui-table-wrap (border, radius-lg, overflow auto, tabIndex 0) > <table class="ui-table">
  <TableCaption />             <caption class="ui-table-caption"> (caption-side: bottom)
  <TableHeader>                <thead>
    <TableRow>
      <TableHead />            <th scope="col" class="ui-table-head">
  <TableBody>                  <tbody>
    <TableRow selected />      <tr data-state="selected">
      <TableCell numeric />    <td class="ui-table-cell" data-align="right" data-numeric>
  <TableFooter />              <tfoot> totals row on --ui-surface-muted
```

#### Props
- `Table`: `striped`, `compact`, `bordered`, `stickyHeader`, `maxHeight` (px or CSS length, the scroll height), `label` (names the scroll region), `wrapperClassName`; all `<table>` props.
- `TableRow`: `selected` → `data-state="selected"`.
- `TableHead` / `TableCell`: `numeric` (right-aligned + tabular-nums), `align` (`left` | `center` | `right`).

#### Visual rules
- Wrapper: 1px `--ui-border`, `--radius-lg`, `--ui-surface`. No shadow.
- Header cells: 44px tall (36px compact), `--ui-surface-muted`, 12px / 500, `--ui-muted-foreground`, nowrap, bottom border `--ui-border`.
- Body cells: 48px tall (36px compact), padding 12px 16px (8px 12px compact), 14px text, bottom hairline `--ui-border-subtle`; last row has none.
- Row hover (fine pointers only): `--ui-accent` at 60%. Selected: `--ui-accent`.
- Striped: even body rows `--ui-surface-muted` at 55%. Bordered: hairline between columns.
- Sticky header: `th` is `position: sticky; top: 0` with a 1px shadow line instead of a border; set `maxHeight`.
- Footer cells: `--ui-surface-muted`, 500 weight, top border.
- Numeric cells right-aligned with `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`; their header is right-aligned too.

#### Motion
- Row background transitions in `--ui-duration-fast`. Nothing else moves.

#### Accessibility
- Native table semantics; `scope="col"` on headers. The wrapper is focusable (keyboard scroll) and becomes a named `region` when `label` is set.
- Selection is shown by colour and must be also exposed by the control inside the row (checkbox).

#### Acceptance checks
- Numbers line up on the right edge in light and dark; header stays visible when scrolling with `stickyHeader`.
- Narrow screens scroll horizontally inside the wrapper, never the page.
- No serious axe violations.

### `ui/components/table/table.tsx`

```tsx
import {
  forwardRef,
  type CSSProperties,
  type HTMLAttributes,
  type TableHTMLAttributes,
  type TdHTMLAttributes,
  type ThHTMLAttributes,
} from 'react';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';

export type TableAlign = 'left' | 'center' | 'right';

export interface TableProps extends TableHTMLAttributes<HTMLTableElement> {
  /** Alternate row tint. */
  striped?: boolean;
  /** Tighter rows (36px instead of 48px). */
  compact?: boolean;
  /** A hairline between columns as well as rows. */
  bordered?: boolean;
  /** Keeps the header row visible while the body scrolls. Pair with `maxHeight`. */
  stickyHeader?: boolean;
  /** Height at which the table body starts scrolling (number is px). */
  maxHeight?: number | string;
  /** Accessible name of the scroll region (recommended for wide tables). */
  label?: string;
  /** Class for the bordered scroll wrapper. */
  wrapperClassName?: string;
}

/**
 * Table — a native `<table>` inside a rounded, scrollable wrapper. The wrapper is
 * focusable so keyboard users can scroll it. Server Component–safe.
 * Compose: TableHeader, TableBody, TableFooter, TableRow, TableHead, TableCell, TableCaption.
 */
export const Table = forwardRef<HTMLTableElement, TableProps>(function Table(
  { striped, compact, bordered, stickyHeader, maxHeight, label, wrapperClassName, className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const style: CSSProperties | undefined = maxHeight !== undefined ? { maxHeight } : undefined;
  return (
    <div
      className={cn('ui-table-wrap', wrapperClassName)}
      style={style}
      tabIndex={0}
      role={label ? 'region' : undefined}
      aria-label={label}
    >
      <table
        ref={ref}
        className={cn(
          'ui-table',
          striped && 'ui-table-striped',
          compact && 'ui-table-compact',
          bordered && 'ui-table-bordered',
          stickyHeader && 'ui-table-sticky',
          className,
        )}
        {...props}
      />
    </div>
  );
});

export const TableHeader = forwardRef<HTMLTableSectionElement, HTMLAttributes<HTMLTableSectionElement>>(function TableHeader(
  { className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return <thead ref={ref} className={cn('ui-table-header', className)} {...props} />;
});

export const TableBody = forwardRef<HTMLTableSectionElement, HTMLAttributes<HTMLTableSectionElement>>(function TableBody(
  { className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return <tbody ref={ref} className={cn('ui-table-body', className)} {...props} />;
});

export const TableFooter = forwardRef<HTMLTableSectionElement, HTMLAttributes<HTMLTableSectionElement>>(function TableFooter(
  { className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return <tfoot ref={ref} className={cn('ui-table-footer', className)} {...props} />;
});

export interface TableRowProps extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLTableRowElement> {
  /** Tints the row as selected (`data-state="selected"`). */
  selected?: boolean;
}

export const TableRow = forwardRef<HTMLTableRowElement, TableRowProps>(function TableRow(
  { selected, className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return <tr ref={ref} className={cn('ui-table-row', className)} data-state={selected ? 'selected' : undefined} {...props} />;
});

export interface TableHeadProps extends ThHTMLAttributes<HTMLTableCellElement> {
  /** Right-aligns and uses tabular figures. Same as `align="right"`. */
  numeric?: boolean;
  align?: TableAlign;
}

export const TableHead = forwardRef<HTMLTableCellElement, TableHeadProps>(function TableHead(
  { numeric, align, scope = 'col', className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return (
    <th
      ref={ref}
      scope={scope}
      className={cn('ui-table-head', className)}
      data-align={align ?? (numeric ? 'right' : undefined)}
      data-numeric={numeric ? '' : undefined}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});

export interface TableCellProps extends TdHTMLAttributes<HTMLTableCellElement> {
  /** Right-aligns and uses tabular figures. Same as `align="right"`. */
  numeric?: boolean;
  align?: TableAlign;
}

export const TableCell = forwardRef<HTMLTableCellElement, TableCellProps>(function TableCell(
  { numeric, align, className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return (
    <td
      ref={ref}
      className={cn('ui-table-cell', className)}
      data-align={align ?? (numeric ? 'right' : undefined)}
      data-numeric={numeric ? '' : undefined}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});

export const TableCaption = forwardRef<HTMLTableCaptionElement, HTMLAttributes<HTMLTableCaptionElement>>(function TableCaption(
  { className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return <caption ref={ref} className={cn('ui-table-caption', className)} {...props} />;
});
```

### `ui/lib/cn.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Join class names, skipping falsy values.
 * No tailwind-merge needed: ui-* classes live in Tailwind's `components`
 * layer, so any utility passed in `className` already wins.
 */
export type ClassValue = string | number | false | null | undefined;

export function cn(...classes: ClassValue[]): string {
  let out = '';
  for (const c of classes) {
    if (!c) continue;
    out = out ? `${out} ${c}` : String(c);
  }
  return out;
}
```

### `ui/styles/components/table.css`

```css
/* Table -------------------------------------------------------------------
   .ui-table-wrap (rounded, scrolls, focusable) > .ui-table
   Modifiers on .ui-table: -striped -compact -bordered -sticky
   Parts: .ui-table-header .ui-table-body .ui-table-footer .ui-table-row
          .ui-table-head .ui-table-cell .ui-table-caption
   Cells: [data-align="left|center|right"], [data-numeric] (tabular figures)
   Row:   [data-state="selected"]
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------ */

@layer components {
  .ui-table-wrap {
    position: relative;
    width: 100%;
    overflow: auto;
    border: 1px solid var(--ui-border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
    background-color: var(--ui-surface);
    color: var(--ui-surface-foreground);
    outline: none;
  }
  .ui-table-wrap:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ring) 45%, transparent); }

  .ui-table {
    width: 100%;
    border-collapse: separate;
    border-spacing: 0;
    font-size: var(--text-sm);
    line-height: 1.4;
    text-align: left;
  }

  .ui-table-head,
  .ui-table-cell {
    padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
    vertical-align: middle;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ui-border-subtle);
    text-align: left;
  }
  .ui-table-head {
    height: 2.75rem;
    padding-block: 0.5rem;
    background-color: var(--ui-surface-muted);
    border-bottom-color: var(--ui-border);
    color: var(--ui-muted-foreground);
    font-size: var(--text-xs);
    font-weight: 500;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .ui-table-cell { height: 3rem; }

  .ui-table-head[data-align="center"], .ui-table-cell[data-align="center"] { text-align: center; }
  .ui-table-head[data-align="right"], .ui-table-cell[data-align="right"] { text-align: right; }
  .ui-table-head[data-numeric], .ui-table-cell[data-numeric] { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

  .ui-table-body:last-child > .ui-table-row:last-child > .ui-table-cell { border-bottom: 0; }

  .ui-table-row { transition: background-color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard); }
  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    .ui-table-body > .ui-table-row:hover { background-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-accent) 60%, transparent); }
  }
  .ui-table-body > .ui-table-row[data-state="selected"] { background-color: var(--ui-accent); }

  .ui-table-footer > .ui-table-row > .ui-table-cell,
  .ui-table-footer > .ui-table-row > .ui-table-head {
    background-color: var(--ui-surface-muted);
    border-top: 1px solid var(--ui-border);
    border-bottom: 0;
    font-weight: 500;
  }

  .ui-table-caption {
    caption-side: bottom;
    padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
    color: var(--ui-muted-foreground);
    font-size: var(--text-xs);
    text-align: left;
  }

  /* Variants */
  .ui-table-striped .ui-table-body > .ui-table-row:nth-child(even) {
    background-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-surface-muted) 55%, transparent);
  }
  .ui-table-striped .ui-table-body > .ui-table-row[data-state="selected"] { background-color: var(--ui-accent); }

  .ui-table-compact .ui-table-head { height: 2.25rem; padding: 0.375rem 0.75rem; }
  .ui-table-compact .ui-table-cell { height: 2.25rem; padding: 0.375rem 0.75rem; }

  .ui-table-bordered .ui-table-head:not(:last-child),
  .ui-table-bordered .ui-table-cell:not(:last-child) { border-right: 1px solid var(--ui-border-subtle); }

  /* Sticky header: scrolls inside the wrapper (set a max-height) */
  .ui-table-sticky .ui-table-head {
    position: sticky;
    top: 0;
    z-index: 1;
    box-shadow: 0 1px 0 var(--ui-border);
    border-bottom-color: transparent;
  }
}
```

## Usage

**Invoices table** — from the docs (`apps/docs/examples/table/invoices.tsx`), imports rewritten to `@/ui/...`:

```tsx
import { Badge } from '@/ui/components/badge';
import { Table, TableBody, TableCaption, TableCell, TableFooter, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from '@/ui/components/table';

const invoices = [
  { id: 'INV-3041', customer: 'Northwind Traders', status: 'paid', due: 'Nov 3, 2025', amount: 4250 },
  { id: 'INV-3042', customer: 'Harbor & Pine', status: 'pending', due: 'Nov 18, 2025', amount: 1840.5 },
  { id: 'INV-3043', customer: 'Lumen Analytics', status: 'paid', due: 'Nov 21, 2025', amount: 12600 },
  { id: 'INV-3044', customer: 'Fieldstone Studio', status: 'overdue', due: 'Oct 29, 2025', amount: 760 },
  { id: 'INV-3045', customer: 'Cobalt Logistics', status: 'pending', due: 'Dec 2, 2025', amount: 3195.25 },
] as const;

const variant = { paid: 'success', pending: 'warning', overdue: 'destructive' } as const;
const money = new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { style: 'currency', currency: 'USD' });
const total = invoices.reduce((sum, invoice) => sum + invoice.amount, 0);

export default function InvoicesTable() {
  return (
    <div className="w-full">
      <Table label="Recent invoices">
        <TableCaption>Invoices issued in the last 30 days.</TableCaption>
        <TableHeader>
          <TableRow>
            <TableHead>Invoice</TableHead>
            <TableHead>Customer</TableHead>
            <TableHead>Status</TableHead>
            <TableHead>Due</TableHead>
            <TableHead numeric>Amount</TableHead>
          </TableRow>
        </TableHeader>
        <TableBody>
          {invoices.map((invoice) => (
            <TableRow key={invoice.id}>
              <TableCell className="font-medium">{invoice.id}</TableCell>
              <TableCell>{invoice.customer}</TableCell>
              <TableCell>
                <Badge variant={variant[invoice.status]} dot>
                  {invoice.status[0].toUpperCase() + invoice.status.slice(1)}
                </Badge>
              </TableCell>
              <TableCell>{invoice.due}</TableCell>
              <TableCell numeric>{money.format(invoice.amount)}</TableCell>
            </TableRow>
          ))}
        </TableBody>
        <TableFooter>
          <TableRow>
            <TableCell colSpan={4}>Total</TableCell>
            <TableCell numeric>{money.format(total)}</TableCell>
          </TableRow>
        </TableFooter>
      </Table>
    </div>
  );
}
```
